en: Famine drives Jacob to send ten sons to Egypt for grain; he keeps Benjamin at home.
They bow down to Joseph, the governor. He recognizes them, but they do not recognize him.
He calls them spies, keeps Simeon bound, and sends them home to bring their youngest brother.
When the grain runs out, Judah guarantees Benjamin's safety, and they return with gifts and Benjamin.
Joseph hides his silver cup in Benjamin's sack, then says the one found with it will be his slave.
Judah offers to stay as a slave in Benjamin's place, so that their father will not die of grief.
Joseph weeps and says, "I am Joseph"; God sent him ahead to save lives. He sends for his father.
zh: 饑荒臨到，雅各打發十個兒子到埃及買糧，卻把便雅憫留在家裏。
他們向埃及的宰相約瑟下拜。約瑟認出了他們，他們卻沒有認出他。
約瑟說他們是奸細，把西緬捆綁留下，打發其餘的人回去帶最小的弟弟來。
糧食吃完了，猶大擔保便雅憫的安全，他們就帶着禮物和便雅憫再下埃及。
約瑟把銀杯藏在便雅憫的袋裏，又說杯在誰那裏找到，誰就要作他的奴僕。
猶大願意留下作奴僕，代替便雅憫，免得父親憂傷而死。
約瑟放聲大哭，說：「我就是約瑟。」神差他先來是為了保全性命。他又打發人去接父親。

about.en: Joseph dreams that his brothers will bow down to him
about.zh: 約瑟夢見哥哥們向他下拜

about.en: The brothers sell Joseph for twenty pieces of silver
about.zh: 哥哥們以二十塊銀子把約瑟賣了

about.en: Stephen tells of the brothers' two journeys to Egypt
about.zh: 司提反講述兄弟們兩次下埃及

en: Egypt's harvests depended on the yearly flooding of the Nile, not on rain, so Egypt often had grain when famine struck Canaan.
A tomb painting at Beni Hasan in Egypt, from about 1890 BC, shows a group of 37 people from western Asia arriving in Egypt.
Egyptian and the Semitic language of Jacob's family were very different, so Joseph could speak to his brothers through an interpreter (42:23).
zh: 埃及的收成靠每年尼羅河氾濫，不靠雨水，所以迦南有饑荒時，埃及往往仍有糧食。
埃及貝尼哈桑一座約公元前1890年的墓中壁畫，描繪了三十七個從西亞來到埃及的人。
埃及話和雅各家所說的閃族語言差別很大，所以約瑟可以藉着傳譯和哥哥們說話（42章23節）。

en: At Beersheba God tells Jacob not to fear going to Egypt: he will make him a great nation there.
Jacob's household, seventy persons in all, comes to Egypt with their livestock.
Joseph meets his father in Goshen, throws his arms around his neck and weeps a long time.
Pharaoh gives them the best of the land, in Goshen, and Jacob, aged 130, blesses Pharaoh.
As the famine goes on, Joseph buys all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh in exchange for food.
Jacob lives seventeen years in Egypt and makes Joseph swear to bury him with his fathers.
After Jacob dies, Joseph tells his fearful brothers: you planned evil, but God planned it for good.
zh: 在別是巴，神對雅各說：不要害怕下埃及去，他要在那裏使雅各成為大國。
雅各全家共七十人，帶着牲畜來到埃及。
約瑟在歌珊迎見父親，抱住他的頸項，哭了許久。
法老把歌珊這上好的地給了他們；一百三十歲的雅各給法老祝福。
饑荒持續，約瑟用糧食換取埃及全地，歸給法老。
雅各在埃及住了十七年，又叫約瑟起誓，要把他葬在祖先的墳地。
雅各死後，哥哥們害怕，約瑟對他們說：你們有意害我，神卻有意使它變為好事。

about.en: God tells Abram his offspring will be foreigners and slaves
about.zh: 神告訴亞伯蘭，他的後裔要寄居外地受奴役

about.en: Stephen tells of Jacob's family going down to Egypt
about.zh: 司提反講述雅各全家下埃及

about.en: Joseph speaks of the exodus and gives orders about his bones
about.zh: 約瑟提到出埃及的事，又吩咐安葬他的骸骨

about.en: Moses takes Joseph's bones out of Egypt
about.zh: 摩西把約瑟的骸骨帶出埃及

en: Goshen was in the eastern Nile Delta, good grazing land on the route toward Canaan; its exact borders are not known.
"The region of Rameses" (47:11) probably takes its name from the later city Pi-Ramesses, built by Ramesses II at Qantir in the eastern Delta.
Egyptians embalmed their dead; Genesis 50 says Jacob's embalming took forty days and Egypt mourned him seventy days.
zh: 歌珊位於尼羅河三角洲東部，是適合放牧的好地方，靠近往迦南的道路；確實的邊界已無從得知。
「蘭塞地」（47章11節）的名稱大概來自後來的培爾‧拉美西斯城；那城由拉美西斯二世建於三角洲東部的坎提爾。
埃及人有用香料保存屍體的習俗；創世記50章說雅各的屍體用了四十天保存，埃及人為他哀哭七十天。

en: Jacob gathers his sons to tell them what will happen to them in the days to come.
Reuben, the firstborn, will not be first, because he went up onto his father's bed.
Simeon and Levi will be scattered in Israel because of their violent anger.
Judah is a lion's cub; the scepter will not depart from Judah, and the peoples will obey him.
Joseph is a fruitful vine, kept strong by the Mighty One of Jacob and blessed by the Almighty.
Jacob speaks to each son, and these are the twelve tribes of Israel.
He asks to be buried in the cave of Machpelah with Abraham and Isaac, then breathes his last.
zh: 雅各召集兒子們，要告訴他們日後必遇的事。
長子流便不再居首位，因為他上了父親的床。
西緬和利未因為暴烈的怒氣，必分散在以色列中。
猶大是隻小獅子；權杖必不離開猶大，萬民都要歸順他。
約瑟是多結果子的葡萄樹，雅各的大能者使他強壯，全能者賜福給他。
雅各向每個兒子說話；這些就是以色列的十二支派。
他吩咐兒子們把他葬在麥比拉洞，與亞伯拉罕和以撒在一起，然後氣絕而死。

about.en: Jacob blesses Joseph's sons, putting Ephraim first
about.zh: 雅各為約瑟的兒子祝福，立以法蓮在前

about.en: Jacob's sons bury him at Machpelah
about.zh: 雅各的兒子們把他葬在麥比拉洞

about.en: By faith Jacob blessed Joseph's sons
about.zh: 雅各因着信為約瑟的兩個兒子祝福

about.en: "The Lion of the tribe of Judah" has conquered
about.zh: 「猶大支派中的獅子」已經得勝

en: The cave of Machpelah is at Hebron; the Cave of the Patriarchs there, inside a great wall built under Herod the Great, is traditionally the site.
In the later division of the land, Levi received towns rather than a territory, and Joseph's portion went to two tribes, Ephraim and Manasseh.
The meaning of "until Shiloh comes" (49:10) is uncertain: it is read as a name, as "to whom it belongs", or as the town of Shiloh.
zh: 麥比拉洞在希伯崙；傳統上認為就是那裏的「列祖之墓」，外面圍着希律王時代建造的高大石牆。
後來分地時，利未只得了城邑，沒有地業；約瑟的一分歸給兩個支派，就是以法蓮和瑪拿西。
「直到細羅來到」（49章10節）的意思並不確定：有人解作人名，有人解作「直到那屬於他的來到」，也有人解作示羅城。

title.zh: 以色列人增多，淪為奴隸

en: Jacob's descendants are in Egypt; Joseph and all his generation die.
The Israelites are fruitful and grow very strong, so that the land is filled with them.
A new king who did not know about Joseph fears them and puts slave masters over them.
They build Pithom and Rameses for Pharaoh, yet the more they are oppressed, the more they multiply.
The king tells the Hebrew midwives, Shiphrah and Puah, to kill every baby boy.
The midwives fear God and let the boys live, and God is good to them.
Pharaoh orders all his people to throw every newborn son into the Nile.
zh: 雅各的後代住在埃及；約瑟和他那一代的人都死了。
以色列人生養眾多，極其強盛，遍滿了那地。
一個不認識約瑟的新王懼怕他們，派監工管轄他們。
他們為法老建造比東和蘭塞；但越受壓迫，人數越多。
埃及王吩咐希伯來的接生婦施弗拉和普阿，把男嬰都殺掉。
接生婦敬畏神，讓男孩活下來；神就厚待她們。
法老吩咐他所有的百姓，把生下來的男孩都丟進尼羅河。

about.en: God foretells that Abram's offspring will be enslaved
about.zh: 神預言亞伯蘭的後裔要受奴役

about.en: Stephen: a king who did not know Joseph oppresses Israel
about.zh: 司提反說：不認識約瑟的王苦待以色列人

about.en: Herod kills the baby boys of Bethlehem
about.zh: 希律殺了伯利恆的男孩

en: Egypt built mostly with mud bricks; a tomb painting of Rekhmire, an official of about 1450 BC, shows foreign workers making bricks.
Pithom and Rameses were in the eastern Nile Delta. Rameses is usually linked with Pi-Ramesses (Qantir); Pithom with Tell el-Maskhuta or Tell er-Retaba.
The Bible does not name this pharaoh; scholars differ on his reign, depending on how they date the exodus.
zh: 埃及的建築多用泥磚；約公元前1450年官員雷克米爾墓中的壁畫，描繪了外族工人製磚的情景。
比東和蘭塞在尼羅河三角洲東部。蘭塞通常認為是培爾‧拉美西斯（坎提爾）；比東則有馬斯胡塔丘或雷塔巴丘兩說。
聖經沒有說出這位法老的名字；學者對他是哪一位意見不一，視乎他們把出埃及定在哪個年代。

en: A Levite man and woman have a son; she sees he is a fine child and hides him for three months.
She puts him in a papyrus basket coated with tar and sets it among the reeds by the Nile.
His sister stands at a distance to see what will happen to him.
Pharaoh's daughter finds the crying baby and feels sorry for him: "one of the Hebrews' children."
His sister offers to find a Hebrew nurse and calls the child's own mother.
When he is older, he becomes the princess's son. She names him Moses: "I drew him out of the water."
zh: 一個利未男人和利未女子生了一個兒子；母親見他俊美，把他藏了三個月。
她把孩子放在塗了柏油的紙莎草籃子裏，放在尼羅河邊的蘆葦中。
孩子的姊姊遠遠站着，要看看他會怎樣。
法老的女兒發現了正在哭的嬰孩，可憐他，說：「這是希伯來人的孩子。」
姊姊提議去找一個希伯來奶媽，就把孩子的母親叫了來。
孩子長大後，成了公主的兒子。她給他取名叫摩西，說：「因為我把他從水裏拉了出來。」

about.en: Moses' parents Amram and Jochebed, and his sister Miriam
about.zh: 摩西的父母暗蘭和約基別，以及姊姊米利暗

about.en: Stephen: Moses brought up and trained in Egypt
about.zh: 司提反說：摩西在埃及長大受教育

about.en: By faith Moses' parents hid him for three months
about.zh: 摩西的父母因着信把他藏了三個月

en: Papyrus grew thickly along the Nile; Egyptians used it for baskets, rope, boats and writing material.
Moses is probably an Egyptian name, like the "-mose" in Ahmose and Thutmose; Exodus links it with the Hebrew verb "draw out".
The Hebrew word for the basket, tevah, is used elsewhere only for Noah's ark.
zh: 尼羅河邊長滿紙莎草；埃及人用它來編籃子、搓繩、造船和造紙。
「摩西」很可能是埃及名字，與雅赫摩斯、圖特摩斯等名字中的「摩斯」相同；出埃及記把它和希伯來文「拉出來」一詞連在一起。
這「籃子」的希伯來文 tevah，在聖經別處只用於挪亞的方舟。

en: Grown up, Moses sees an Egyptian beating a Hebrew. He kills the Egyptian and hides him in the sand.
The next day a Hebrew asks him, "Who made you a ruler and judge over us?" Moses is afraid.
Pharaoh tries to kill Moses, so he flees to the land of Midian and sits down by a well.
He rescues the seven daughters of the priest of Midian from shepherds and waters their flock.
Their father Reuel gives Moses his daughter Zipporah; their son is Gershom: "a foreigner in a foreign land."
The king of Egypt dies. The Israelites cry out, and God remembers his covenant with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob.
zh: 摩西長大後，看見一個埃及人毆打希伯來人，就打死那埃及人，把他埋在沙土裏。
第二天，一個希伯來人問他：「誰立你作我們的首領和審判官呢？」摩西就害怕了。
法老想殺摩西，摩西就逃到米甸地，坐在一口井旁。
他救了米甸祭司的七個女兒，不讓牧人欺負她們，又替她們給羊群喝水。
她們的父親流珥把女兒西坡拉嫁給摩西；他們的兒子叫革舜，因為摩西說：「我在外地作了外人。」
埃及王死了。以色列人哀號求救，神就記起他與亞伯拉罕、以撒和雅各所立的約。

about.en: Stephen: Moses at forty, and his flight to Midian
about.zh: 司提反講述摩西四十歲時的事和逃往米甸

about.en: By faith Moses refused to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter
about.zh: 摩西因着信不肯稱為法老女兒的兒子

about.en: Jethro, Moses' father-in-law, visits him after the exodus
about.zh: 摩西的岳父葉忒羅在出埃及後來探望他

en: Midian lay east of the Gulf of Aqaba, in northwest Arabia; Midianite herders also roamed Sinai and the Negev.
The priest of Midian is called Reuel here and Jethro in 3:1 and 18:1; scholars differ on why he has two names.
Stephen says Moses was forty when he fled and spent forty years in Midian (Acts 7:23, 30); Exodus 7:7 gives his age as eighty before Pharaoh.
zh: 米甸位於亞喀巴灣以東，在今天阿拉伯半島西北部；米甸的牧民也在西奈和南地一帶遊牧。
米甸祭司在這裏叫流珥，在3章1節和18章1節叫葉忒羅；學者對他為何有兩個名字看法不一。
司提反說摩西逃走時四十歲，在米甸住了四十年（使徒行傳7章23、30節）；出埃及記7章7節說他見法老時八十歲。

en: Tending Jethro's flock at Horeb, Moses sees a bush burning with fire but not burned up.
God calls from the bush: take off your sandals; I am the God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob.
The LORD has seen his people's misery and sends Moses to Pharaoh to bring them out of Egypt.
Moses asks, "Who am I?" God says, "I will be with you," and gives his name: "I am who I am."
God gives signs: the staff becomes a snake, his hand becomes diseased and is healed, Nile water will become blood.
Moses says he is slow of speech and asks God to send someone else; God appoints Aaron to speak for him.
Moses returns to Egypt. Aaron tells the elders, and the people believe and worship.
zh: 摩西在何烈山放葉忒羅的羊，看見荊棘被火燒着，卻沒有燒毀。
神從荊棘中呼叫他：把鞋脫下來；我是亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各的神。
耶和華看見了他子民的苦情，要差摩西去見法老，把他們從埃及領出來。
摩西說：「我是甚麼人？」神說：「我必與你同在。」又說出自己的名：「我就是我。」
神賜他神蹟：杖變成蛇，手長了皮膚病又復原，尼羅河的水要變成血。
摩西說自己拙口笨舌，求神差別人去；神就派亞倫替他說話。
摩西回到埃及。亞倫把話告訴長老，百姓就信了，並且下拜敬拜。

about.en: Stephen tells of the burning bush
about.zh: 司提反講述燃燒的荊棘

about.en: Jesus quotes God's words to Moses at the bush
about.zh: 耶穌引用神在荊棘中對摩西說的話

about.en: Jesus: "Before Abraham was, I am"
about.zh: 耶穌說：「還沒有亞伯拉罕，我就是。」

en: Horeb is another name for Mount Sinai. Its location is uncertain; Jebel Musa in southern Sinai is the traditional site, with St Catherine's Monastery (6th century AD) at its foot.
God's name, the LORD (Hebrew YHWH, probably pronounced Yahweh), is linked in 3:14–15 with the verb "to be". Later Jews avoided saying it and read "Adonai" (Lord) instead.
zh: 何烈山是西奈山的另一個名字，位置並不確定；傳統認為是西奈半島南部的穆薩山，山腳有公元六世紀建的聖凱瑟琳修道院。
神的名字「耶和華」（希伯來文 YHWH，讀音可能是「雅威」），在3章14至15節與「是」這個動詞相連。後來猶太人避免念出這名，改讀「阿多乃」（主）。

en: Moses and Aaron tell Pharaoh, "Let my people go." Pharaoh answers, "Who is the LORD? I do not know the LORD."
Pharaoh stops giving the people straw, yet demands the same number of bricks.
The Israelite foremen are beaten, and they blame Moses and Aaron.
Moses asks the LORD, "Why have you brought trouble on this people? Why did you ever send me?"
God says, "I am the LORD": he will bring them out, take them as his people and give them the land.
The Israelites do not listen to Moses, because they are so discouraged and their labor is so hard.
A list of Levi's family shows the line of Moses and Aaron.
zh: 摩西和亞倫對法老說：「讓我的子民走。」法老說：「耶和華是誰？我不認識耶和華。」
法老不再給百姓草，卻要他們做出和從前一樣多的磚。
以色列的工頭被打，就埋怨摩西和亞倫。
摩西問耶和華：「你為甚麼苦待這百姓？為甚麼差我來？」
神說：「我是耶和華。」他要領他們出來，以他們為子民，把那地賜給他們。
以色列人因為灰心和苦工，不肯聽摩西的話。
經文列出利未的家譜，記下摩西和亞倫的家系。

about.en: God's covenant with Abraham: to be their God and give the land
about.zh: 神與亞伯拉罕立約：作他們的神，賜他們那地

about.en: A psalm: Israel in Egypt, and God sends Moses and Aaron
about.zh: 詩篇：以色列在埃及，神差派摩西和亞倫

en: Egyptian bricks were made of Nile mud mixed with straw or chaff, shaped in wooden molds and dried in the sun.
An Egyptian leather scroll from the reign of Ramesses II (13th century BC) records daily brick quotas set for work gangs.
"Pharaoh" comes from the Egyptian for "great house", first meaning the palace and later the king himself.
zh: 埃及的磚用尼羅河的泥加上草或糠，放在木模裏成形，再在太陽下曬乾。
一卷拉美西斯二世時期（公元前十三世紀）的埃及皮卷，記載了給工人隊伍定下的每日造磚數額。
「法老」來自埃及文「大房子」一詞，起初指王宮，後來用來稱呼國王本人。

en: Aaron's staff becomes a serpent and swallows the staffs of Pharaoh's magicians, but Pharaoh's heart grows hard.
Aaron strikes the Nile, and its water turns to blood; the fish die and the river stinks.
Frogs cover the land. Pharaoh asks Moses to pray, but when there is relief he makes his heart stubborn.
Dust becomes gnats. The magicians cannot copy it and say, "This is the finger of God."
Swarms of flies fill Egypt, but not the land of Goshen, where the Israelites live.
The Egyptians' livestock die, and soot thrown into the air brings boils on people and animals.
Hail and fire strike Egypt, but not Goshen. Pharaoh says, "I have sinned," then hardens his heart again.
zh: 亞倫的杖變成蛇，吞了法老術士的杖；法老的心卻剛硬。
亞倫擊打尼羅河，河水變成血，魚都死了，河也發臭。
青蛙遍滿全地。法老求摩西禱告，災禍一停，他又頑固起來。
塵土變成蚊子。術士做不到，就說：「這是神的手指。」
成群的蒼蠅遍滿埃及，以色列人所住的歌珊地卻沒有。
埃及人的牲畜死了；摩西把爐灰揚向空中，人和牲畜都長了毒瘡。
冰雹和火降在埃及，歌珊地卻沒有。法老說：「我犯了罪。」後來又硬着心。

about.en: A psalm recounts the plagues on Egypt
about.zh: 詩篇追述埃及所受的災禍

about.en: Jesus drives out demons "by the finger of God"
about.zh: 耶穌「靠神的手指」趕鬼

about.en: Paul quotes God's words to Pharaoh (Exodus 9:16)
about.zh: 保羅引用神對法老說的話（出9章16節）

about.en: The bowls of wrath: sores, and seas and rivers turned to blood
about.zh: 盛怒的碗：毒瘡，海和江河變成血

en: Almost all Egyptians lived in the narrow Nile valley and delta; they honored the river's yearly flood as the god Hapi.
In Egypt barley and flax ripen around February and March, wheat and spelt about a month later, as 9:31–32 describes.
This site follows the Hebrew numbering: Exodus 7:26–29 and 8:1–28 here are 8:1–32 in most English Bibles.
zh: 幾乎所有埃及人都住在狹長的尼羅河谷和三角洲；他們把每年的河水氾濫尊為哈比神。
在埃及，大麥和亞麻約在二、三月成熟，小麥和粗麥晚一個月左右，與9章31至32節所說的相合。
本站依照希伯來文的節數：這裏的出埃及記7章26至29節和8章1至28節，在多數英文聖經是8章1至32節。

en: Pharaoh's officials beg him to let the people go, but he will let only the men go.
An east wind brings locusts that eat every plant the hail has left.
Pharaoh admits his sin; a west wind drives the locusts into the Red Sea, but he does not let Israel go.
Thick darkness covers Egypt for three days, but the Israelites have light where they live.
Pharaoh would keep their flocks; Moses refuses, and Pharaoh tells him never to see his face again.
Moses announces that about midnight every firstborn in Egypt will die, but not among the Israelites.
zh: 法老的臣僕求他放百姓走，他卻只准男人去。
東風颳來蝗蟲，把冰雹打剩的植物都吃光了。
法老承認自己有罪；西風把蝗蟲颳進紅海，他卻仍不放以色列人走。
濃密的黑暗籠罩埃及三天，以色列人住的地方卻有亮光。
法老要留下他們的牛羊，摩西不肯；法老就叫他永遠不要再見他的面。
摩西宣告：約在半夜，埃及所有頭生的都要死，以色列人中卻不會這樣。

about.en: A psalm recalls the signs in Egypt, down to the firstborn
about.zh: 詩篇追述在埃及的神蹟，直到擊殺長子

about.en: The fifth bowl plunges the beast's kingdom into darkness
about.zh: 第五碗使獸的國度陷入黑暗

about.en: The last plague comes, and Pharaoh lets Israel go
about.zh: 最後的災禍臨到，法老讓以色列人走

en: Desert locust swarms still strike Egypt and the Near East; one swarm can hold hundreds of millions of insects and strip fields in hours.
Egyptians worshiped the sun god Ra as one of their chief gods, and the pharaoh was called "son of Ra".
zh: 沙漠蝗蟲至今仍侵襲埃及和近東；一群蝗蟲可達數以億計，幾小時內就能把田地吃光。
埃及人敬拜太陽神拉，視他為主要的神明之一；法老被稱為「拉的兒子」。

en: The LORD tells Moses and Aaron that this month will be the first month of their year.
Each household is to take a lamb without defect and slaughter it at twilight on the fourteenth day.
They put its blood on the doorposts and eat it roasted, with unleavened bread and bitter herbs, ready to leave.
"When I see the blood, I will pass over you": the LORD will strike every firstborn in Egypt.
At midnight every firstborn in Egypt dies, and Pharaoh tells Moses and Aaron to go.
The Israelites leave in haste with unrisen dough, setting out from Rameses for Succoth.
About six hundred thousand men on foot go out, after 430 years in Egypt.
zh: 耶和華對摩西和亞倫說，這個月要作他們一年的第一個月。
每家要取一隻沒有殘疾的羊羔，在十四日黃昏宰殺。
他們要把血塗在門框上，把羊羔烤了，和無酵餅、苦菜一同吃，並且要穿戴整齊準備起行。
「我一看見這血，就越過你們去。」耶和華要擊殺埃及地所有頭生的。
半夜，埃及所有頭生的都死了；法老叫摩西和亞倫離去。
以色列人帶着還沒發起的麵團匆匆離開，從蘭塞起行往疏割去。
步行的男人約有六十萬；他們在埃及住了四百三十年。

about.en: Jesus sends Peter and John to prepare the Passover
about.zh: 耶穌打發彼得和約翰去預備逾越節

about.en: "Christ, our Passover lamb, has been sacrificed"
about.zh: 「我們逾越節的羊羔基督已經被獻為祭」

about.en: John: "Look, the Lamb of God"
about.zh: 約翰說：「看哪，神的羔羊！」

about.en: "Not one of his bones will be broken" (Exodus 12:46)
about.zh: 「他的骨頭一根也不可折斷」（出12章46節）

en: Jews still keep Passover (Hebrew Pesach) each spring, in the month of Nisan (Abib in 13:4), in March or April.
Hyssop (12:22), used to put on the blood, is probably Syrian marjoram, a small bushy plant.
Many date the exodus to about 1446 BC; others to about 1260 BC.
zh: 猶太人至今每年春天守逾越節（希伯來文 Pesach），在尼散月（13章4節稱亞筆月），約在公曆三、四月間。
用來塗血的牛膝草（12章22節），很可能是敘利亞馬鬱蘭，一種矮小叢生的植物。
許多人把出埃及定在約公元前1446年，也有人定在約公元前1260年。

title.en: The parting of the Red Sea

en: God leads the people by the wilderness road toward the Red Sea, not through the land of the Philistines. Moses takes Joseph's bones.
The LORD goes ahead of them in a pillar of cloud by day and a pillar of fire by night.
Pharaoh pursues with six hundred select chariots and overtakes them camped by the sea.
The terrified people cry out. Moses says, "The LORD will fight for you. You need only to be still."
Moses stretches out his hand; a strong east wind drives the sea back all night, and Israel crosses on dry ground.
The Egyptians follow; at daybreak the waters return and cover Pharaoh's whole army.
The people fear the LORD and believe in the LORD and in his servant Moses.
zh: 神領百姓走曠野的路往紅海去，不經過非利士人的地。摩西帶着約瑟的骸骨。
耶和華在他們前面行，日間在雲柱中，夜間在火柱中。
法老帶着六百輛精選的戰車追趕，在海邊追上了安營的以色列人。
百姓非常害怕，大聲哀求。摩西說：「耶和華會為你們爭戰，你們只要安靜。」
摩西向海伸手，耶和華用強勁的東風整夜使海水退去，以色列人在海中走乾地。
埃及人追進海中；天亮時海水回流，淹沒了法老的全軍。
百姓就敬畏耶和華，信服耶和華和他的僕人摩西。

about.en: Moses and Miriam sing to the LORD
about.zh: 摩西和米利暗向耶和華歌唱

about.en: A psalm: God led them through the depths
about.zh: 詩篇：神領他們經過深水

about.en: Paul: all passed through the sea, under the cloud
about.zh: 保羅說：他們都在雲下，都從海中經過

about.en: By faith the people crossed the Red Sea
about.zh: 百姓因着信過紅海

en: "Red Sea" is in Hebrew yam suph, "sea of reeds"; the same name is used for the Gulf of Aqaba. The crossing place is uncertain.
"The road through the land of the Philistines" was the coastal road from Egypt to Canaan, guarded by a chain of Egyptian forts.
Egyptian chariots were light, two-wheeled and drawn by two horses, usually carrying a driver and a warrior.
zh: 「紅海」的希伯來文是 yam suph，意思是「蘆葦海」；亞喀巴灣也用這名字。過海的確實地點並不確定。
「經過非利士人之地的路」是從埃及到迦南的沿海大道，沿路有一連串埃及的堡壘把守。
埃及的戰車輕巧，有兩個輪子，由兩匹馬拉動，通常載着一個駕車的和一個戰士。
